title: (RHBA-2020:2195) Update to Fuse 7.6.0 Fuse Online and Fuse on Openshift images
portal_summary: Red Hat Fuse 7.6.0 update of 'Fuse Online' and 'Fuse on Openshift' images.
portal_synopsis: Update to Fuse 7.6.0 Fuse Online and Fuse on Openshift images
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.10|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.11|x86_64
portal_solution:
This release consists of the following parts:
* Fuse Online images (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)
* Fuse on Openshift images (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)

For details of how to update the images for Fuse 7.6 on OpenShift, see the
following section of the Fuse on OpenShift Guide:
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_fuse/7.6/html-single/fuse_on_openshift_guide/index#patch-fuse-on-openshift-images

For details of how to update the images for Fuse 7.6 Online, see the following
section of the Installing and Operating Fuse Online on OpenShift Container Platform guide:
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_fuse/7.6/html/installing_and_operating_fuse_online_on_openshift_container_platform/managing-fuse-online-on-ocp_ocp#upgrade-on-ocp_manage
portal_description: This advisory makes available an update to the images for Fuse Online and Fuse on Openshift for Red Hat Fuse 7.6.0.
